task_description: Write a class called LRUCache with methods get(key) and put(key, value), implementing a least-recently-used cache with a fixed capacity passed to the constructor.
test_code:
assert (lambda c: (c.put(1,1), c.get(1))[1] == 1)(solution(2))
assert (lambda c: c.get(2) == -1)(solution(2))
assert (lambda c: (c.put(1,1), c.put(2,2), c.put(3,3), c.get(1), c.get(2), c.get(3)) == (None, None, None, -1, 2, 3))(solution(2))
assert (lambda c: (c.put(1,1), c.put(2,2), c.get(1), c.put(3,3), c.get(2), c.get(1), c.get(3)) == (None, None, 1, None, -1, 1, 3))(solution(2))
assert (lambda c: (c.put(1,1), c.get(1)) == (None, -1))(solution(0))
print("ALL TESTS PASSED")
